metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1994 · Crumb
metas.description: An intimate portrait of controversial cartoonist Robert Crumb and his traumatized family.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1999 · My Best Fiend
metas.description: The love-hate relationship between Werner Herzog and Klaus Kinski, the deep trust between the director and the actor, and their independently and simultaneously hatched plans to murder one another.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1999 · Beyond the Mat
metas.description: A heartfelt documentary focusing on the day-to-day lives of professional wrestlers, some on the rise, some on the wane, and others fighting for their lives.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1997 · Iruvar
metas.description: A struggling actor and a writer-politician become friends as young men and rise to great heights in cinema and politics respectively. But when both become contenders for the top political post in the state, a rift develops between...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1991 · Tous les matins du monde
metas.description: The story of Monsieur de Sainte Colombe, fierce and somber man, grand master of the viola da gamba and professor of Marin Marais, prestigious musician in the court of Louis XIV.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1990 · My Father's Glory
metas.description: At the end of the nineteenth century, little Marcel lives with his parents in the Provence countryside. During his holiday, Marcel meets Lili, a local boy who knows all the secrets of the hills, and the two become fast friends.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1997 · Little Dieter Needs to Fly
metas.description: German-American Dieter Dengler discusses his service as a U.S. naval pilot in the Vietnam War. Dengler also revisits the sites of his capture and eventual escape from the hands of the Viet Cong, recreating many events for the camera.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1990 · My Mother's Castle
metas.description: Every holiday Marcel and his family go to their cottage near Marseilles. During one of these holidays he meets Isabelle, a pretty but conceited girl... Adapted from the cult classic novel from Marcel Pagnol.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1994 · Bandit Queen
metas.description: The story of the bandit queen Phoolan Devi who was sent to prison in 1983 and got free in 1994.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1992 · Manufacturing Consent: Noam Chomsky and the Media
metas.description: A film about the noted American linguist/political dissident and his warning about corporate media's role in modern propaganda.
